family.description: This domain, and the associated ANK family repeat [pfam:PF00023] domain, are found in ANKRD13 of which at least 4 subtypes are known to exist, termed A-D. ANKRD13C act as a chaperone for biogenesis and folding of the DP receptor for prostaglandin D2 [[cite:PUB00057233]]. ANKRD13A/B/D are ubiquitin-binding proteins that specifically recognise and bind Lys-63-linked ubiquitin. They positively regulate the internalisation of ligand-activated EGFR by binding to the Ub moiety of ubiquitinated EGFR at the cell membrane [[cite:PUB00155297]].
family.name: ANKRD13 C-terminal
